bio: In a delightful village on the banks of the Aisne in the heart of Compiègne Forest, this inn sports a traditional exterior and a modern, pared-back interior. Alfresco dining is bliss in fine weather on the terrace overlooking a landscaped garden. The score errs towards the traditional: pâté en croûte, veal kidneys in mustard, crème brûlée or soufflé to finish. The chef puts the finishing touches to carefully sourced seasonal ingredients, delivering an experience that is both authentic and polished....
